title: The Lantern Festival Planning Meeting
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答8个问题。短文和问题均为英文，解释为中文。所有内容为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。请先通读全文，再作答。
passage: Last week, a group of neighbours met in the community hall. They were planning a lantern festival for the town. Mrs Chen was leading the meeting. While she was writing notes on the board, Mr Li arrived with a box of old lanterns. "These are from my grandfather," he said. "He was a lantern maker." The group needed a theme. A young woman named Anna suggested "Stories of Our Town." Everyone liked the idea. They decided to ask people to make lanterns about local people. One lantern would show the baker who opens his shop at 5 a.m. Another would show the nurse who works at the small clinic. Mrs Chen said, "We need a place for the event." Mr Li said the park was free on Saturday. While they were talking, the town librarian came in. She offered to display old photos of the town. The group was happy. They planned to meet again on Thursday. At the end, Mrs Chen said, "Remember, the lanterns which we make must be safe." Everyone agreed. The festival will be on the last Saturday of the month.

grammar.title: 过去进行时入门；when / while；who / which / that 定语从句入门
grammar.explanation: 过去进行时表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，结构是 was/were + 动词-ing。常与 when 或 while 连用：when 后常接一般过去时（突然发生的动作），while 后常接过去进行时（持续的动作）。定语从句用来修饰名词：who 指人，which 指物，that 既可指人也可指物。例如：The man who is talking is my uncle. The book which is on the desk is mine.
grammar.example: While she was writing notes on the board, Mr Li arrived with a box of old lanterns.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: While I ______ dinner, the phone rang.
questions.explanation: while 引导的持续动作常用过去进行时，结构为 was/were + doing。
questions.evidence: While she was writing notes on the board, Mr Li arrived with a box of old lanterns.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The girl ______ won the prize is my sister.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the girl 指人，定语从句用 who。
questions.evidence: One lantern would show the baker who opens his shop at 5 a.m.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: This is the book ______ I bought yesterday.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the book 指物，定语从句用 which。
questions.evidence: Remember, the lanterns which we make must be safe.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: They ______ football when it started to rain.
questions.explanation: when 从句表示突然发生的动作，主句表示正在进行的动作，用过去进行时。
questions.evidence: While she was writing notes on the board, Mr Li arrived with a box of old lanterns.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The man ______ is talking to Mrs Chen is Mr Li.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the man 指人，定语从句用 who。
questions.evidence: One lantern would show the baker who opens his shop at 5 a.m.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: I like the lanterns ______ are red.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the lanterns 指物，定语从句用 which。
questions.evidence: Remember, the lanterns which we make must be safe.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: While she ______ the lantern, she saw a bird.
questions.explanation: while 引导的持续动作常用过去进行时，结构为 was/were + doing。
questions.evidence: While she was writing notes on the board, Mr Li arrived with a box of old lanterns.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The nurse ______ works at the clinic is very kind.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the nurse 指人，定语从句用 who。
questions.evidence: Another would show the nurse who works at the small clinic.
